ResearchProjectDef.label: metallic arts
ResearchProjectDef.description: The arcane foundation of Scadrial’s power. This research unlocks the framework for all Metallic Arts—Allomancy, Feruchemy, and Hemalurgy—granting colonists the potential to tap into Investiture through metal.

rulesStrings.li: subject->the Metallic Arts
subject_story->catalogued sixteen metals and the argument about the sixteenth
subject_story->wrote the primer that every later scholar of the Arts complained about and used
subject_story->spent a life on the question of why it is metal at all
subject_gerund->studying the Metallic Arts

ResearchProjectDef.label: allomancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Harness the power of metal to enhance the body and mind. Allomancers consume metal vials to unlock supernatural abilities such as strength, speed, and influence over others. This research enables the use of Allomantic genes, abilities, and resources.

rulesStrings.li: subject->Allomancy
subject_story->burned a metal for the first time and wrote down the exact hour
subject_story->tested every metal on themselves and recorded the ones that hurt
subject_story->proved which powers are which, using nothing but patience and bruises
subject_gerund->studying Allomancy

ResearchProjectDef.label: feruchemy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master the art of balance through storage and retrieval. Feruchemists store their own attributes—such as health, speed, and senses—within metal and draw upon them when needed. Unlocks Feruchemical mechanics, metalminds, and corresponding genetics.

rulesStrings.li: subject->Feruchemy
subject_story->kept a metalmind ledger for sixty years and never lost a day to it
subject_story->worked out the exact price of storing health, and paid it deliberately
subject_story->explained the balance of Feruchemy to a room that did not want to hear it
subject_gerund->studying Feruchemy

ResearchProjectDef.label: compounding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Burn a metalmind's own metal to draw out what was stored within it, magnified far beyond what was put in. Compounding demands both arts at once, and a metalmind carried inside the body where Allomancy can reach it.

rulesStrings.li: subject->compounding
subject_story->found the loophole between the two Arts and understood what it cost
subject_story->wrote out the compounding ratios and then hid the pages
subject_story->proved that the balance can be cheated, and was afraid of the proof
subject_gerund->compounding metals

ResearchProjectDef.label: hemalurgy
ResearchProjectDef.description: The darkest of the Metallic Arts. Hemalurgy transfers power from one being to another through the violent act of spiking. This research unveils forbidden knowledge: how to craft and implant hemalurgic spikes, and the means to extract abilities - at a cost.

rulesStrings.li: subject->Hemalurgy
subject_story->studied the third Art and could not make the notes sound clean
subject_story->documented what a spike takes and what it never gives back
subject_story->wrote the only honest account of Hemalurgy and burned two drafts first
subject_gerund->studying Hemalurgy
